assumptions: The two separately printed parts are assembled by engaging the rear open channels with the guide ropes.
The broad planar rear faces are the intended support-free print orientation.

components.form: Tapered smiling wrapper with an attached floor and two stout vertical guide ropes.
components.interfaces: Two guide ropes engage the cap's rear open channels with geometry-defined lower and raised stops.
components.name: Wrapper and guide base
components.placement: Lower fixed part, centered beneath the sliding frosting cap.
components.purpose: Acts as the cupcake wrapper when lowered and the balloon basket when raised while retaining the cap on two guide ropes.

components.form: Tapered lobed cap with face details, cherry, stem grip, rear channels, and integral stop geometry.
components.interfaces: Rear open channels slide over the base guide ropes at slip clearance and terminate at modeled endpoints.
components.name: Frosting and cherry sliding cap
components.placement: Upper moving part, aligned over the wrapper base through the full 28 mm travel.
components.purpose: Reads as frosting in the closed state and as the hot-air-balloon envelope in the raised state.

concept.intended_interaction: Hold the wrapper base upright, grasp the cherry stem, and slide the frosting cap upward to its raised stop; slide it down again to return the balloon to a cupcake.

light_setup.alignment: Broad face parallel to a pale wall; cherry arrow points from phone toward wall

concept.mechanism: A two-part, broad-face-down printable caster. The wrapper base owns two stout vertical guide-ropes; the frosting cap slides on rear open channels between geometry-defined lower and raised stops. Lowered, the filled frosting overlaps and hides the guides. Raised, the same frosting is the balloon envelope, the guides are ropes, and the wrapper is the basket.
concept.print_strategy: Both parts print separately on broad planar faces without support; no purchased hardware, glue, magnets, or electronics.
concept.signature_decision: The unmistakable signature is one vertical cherry lift transforming the same smiling frosting silhouette into a hot-air-balloon envelope, while the cupcake wrapper visibly becomes its basket.
concept.summary: Lift the cherry on a smiling cupcake and its structural silhouette becomes a hot-air balloon on the wall.
concept.title: Frosting Aloft
unresolved_risks: Physical sliding feel, durability, and projected-shadow recognition remain unverified until a real print is tested.

research.basis: Wish-authored analog comparison and explicit Orin Shadow method; no external factual claim is needed to define the printable mechanism.
digital_evidence_plan: Exact lowered, midpoint, and raised state geometry
honest_limits: Digital evidence does not verify phone multi-emitter sharpness, room-light tolerance, physical sliding fit, durability, or human recognition.
Lamp and wall distance bands remain operating guidance until physically tested.
research.selected_inventor_review: Orin Shadow independently recommended 27-30 mm travel, 4-5 mm guide widths near x=±15 mm, broad-face printing, coplanar shadow edges, and geometry-defined stops.
